identify: The caterpillar has stripes along the body.
It feeds at dawn and dusk because it avoids sunlight.
damage: The main sign is loss of leaves. The larvae chew the leaves from the edges. They can cut the neck of the cereal head.

thresholds.etl: Maize: Armyworm One larva per plant.

cultural: Check the field often for the pest and its natural enemies.
Grow barrier crops like mustard around the field.
biological: Protect natural enemies in the field.
